Scientists trace a rare signal across the Pacific after months of careful observation

Researchers said the signal appeared repeatedly during overnight monitoring sessions, giving the team enough evidence to compare it with earlier measurements from coastal stations.

The findings do not point to a single cause yet, but they offer a clearer map of how the signal moved through the region and why previous instruments missed it during shorter surveys.
